name: Trace distribuído
description: Spans app (Tech Challenge POS) ↔ payment-service via W3C trace context; filtro por O.S. via trace.id dos logs

rawConfiguration.text:
### Trace distribuído — visão geral
Spans dos dois serviços com agente New Relic: **Tech Challenge POS** (app no EKS, agente PHP) e **payment-service** (Lambdas, agente Node.js). Os dois propagam headers W3C, então as chamadas HTTP app → payment (gerar link, cancelar) e payment → app (`/api/payment/callback/{token}`, `/api/payment/notification`) entram no mesmo trace.

O **services-ms** não gera spans: conversa por SQS/Step Functions e usa correlação por `service_order_id` (dashboard *Jornada da O.S.*).

Para abrir um trace: copie o `trace.id` de uma tabela e procure em **APM → Distributed tracing**.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(trace.id) AS 'Traces' FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') SINCE 1 day ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago

widgets.title: Traces que cruzam app e payment

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(trace.id) AS 'Traces app ↔ payment' FROM Span WHERE appName = 'Tech Challenge POS' AND trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'payment-service') SINCE 1 day ago

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error.class IS NOT NULL) AS '% spans com erro', filter(count(*), WHERE error.class IS NOT NULL) AS 'Spans com erro' FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Latência das entradas (p50 / p95) por serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95) FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') AND nr.entryPoint IS TRUE FACET appName TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') AND error.class IS NOT NULL FACET appName, error.class TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Chamadas entre serviços e externas (quem chama quem)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Chamadas', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', percentage(count(*), WHERE error.class IS NOT NULL OR numeric(http.statusCode) >= 400) AS '% erro' FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') AND span.kind = 'client' AND http.url IS NOT NULL FACET appName AS 'Origem', capture(http.url, r'https?://(?P<host>[^/:?]+).*') AS 'Destino' SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 50

SELECT sum(duration.ms) / 1000 AS 'Segundos' FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') AND span.kind = 'client' AND http.url IS NOT NULL FACET capture(http.url, r'https?://(?P<host>[^/:?]+).*') SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Fluxo de pagamento — entradas por etapa

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE nr.entryPoint IS TRUE AND (appName = 'payment-service' OR (appName = 'Tech Challenge POS' AND (name LIKE '%payment%' OR name LIKE '%service-order%'))) FACET appName, name TIMESERIES SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)' FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') FACET appName, name SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 15

SELECT max(duration.ms) AS 'Duração do maior span (ms)', uniqueCount(appName) AS 'Serviços', uniques(appName) AS 'Quais', count(*) AS 'Spans', filter(count(*), WHERE error.class IS NOT NULL) AS 'Erros', min(timestamp) AS 'Início' FROM Span WHERE appName IN ('Tech Challenge POS', 'payment-service') FACET trace.id SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 50

rawConfiguration.text:
### Trace de uma O.S.
Preencha **Id da O.S.** no topo. Os traces são achados pelos logs da aplicação que têm `context.service_order_id` — o agente PHP grava o `trace.id` em cada log. A partir deles, aparecem todos os spans do trace, inclusive os do payment-service.

Passos do services-ms (sem spans) estão no dashboard *Jornada da O.S.*.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(trace.id) AS 'Traces' FROM Span WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Log WHERE context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} AND trace.id IS NOT NULL) SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Spans', filter(count(*), WHERE error.class IS NOT NULL) AS 'Com erro' FROM Span WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Log WHERE context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} AND trace.id IS NOT NULL) SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT sum(duration.ms) FROM Span WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Log WHERE context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} AND trace.id IS NOT NULL) AND nr.entryPoint IS TRUE FACET appName SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT min(timestamp) AS 'Início', latest(name) AS 'Operação', uniques(appName) AS 'Serviços', count(*) AS 'Spans', max(duration.ms) AS 'Maior span (ms)', filter(count(*), WHERE error.class IS NOT NULL) AS 'Erros' FROM Span WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Log WHERE context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} AND trace.id IS NOT NULL) FACET trace.id SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 100

SELECT timestamp, trace.id, appName AS 'Serviço', name AS 'Operação', span.kind, duration.ms, http.url, http.statusCode, error.class, error.message FROM Span WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Log WHERE context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} AND trace.id IS NOT NULL) SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT MAX

SELECT count(*) AS 'Chamadas', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', latest(http.statusCode) AS 'Último status' FROM Span WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Log WHERE context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} AND trace.id IS NOT NULL) AND span.kind = 'client' FACET appName AS 'Origem', capture(http.url, r'https?://(?P<host>[^/:?]+).*') AS 'Destino' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT timestamp, entity.name, trace.id, level, message FROM Log WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT uniques(trace.id) FROM Log WHERE context.service_order_id = {{service_order_id}} AND trace.id IS NOT NULL) SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT MAX
